scope: Dominant natural is/was path from the post-cue MLP8 bilinear product to the shared temporal-Q8 state through attention9 heads 1 and 4 at the final query.

state.name: Q8
state.gauge: Only the eight-dimensional projector and contracted maps are identified; coordinates are invariant up to an invertible basis change.

program.name: remove_direct_q8_hidden_modes
program.equation: delta_h_perp = (I - V8 V8^T) delta_h, where rows(V8) span S_Q8^T W_Down
program.interpretation: The dominant route begins in the exact hidden-product complement of direct Q8 Down modes.

program.name: mlp8_down_and_block9_recurrence
program.equation: delta_z9 = lambda9 * (Down(h_base + delta_h_perp) - Down(h_base)); z9_prime = z9_base + delta_z9

program.name: state_conditioned_value_read
program.initial_value_branch: exactly zero in the confirmed intervention

program.name: base_pattern_transport_to_final_query
program.equation: response_h(query) = sum_{s in postcue} P_base[h,query,s] * delta_V[h,s]
program.interpretation: Native attention routing transports an input-dependent value update; pattern change and pattern-value interaction are small.

program.name: project_and_write_q8
program.equation: delta_resid = sum_{h in {1,4}} F.linear(response_h, W_cproj[:,head_slice_h]); q8 = delta_resid * S_Q8

factor_necessity.decision: retain all three exact bilinear terms

causal_coverage.status: High-quality dominant path, not yet a globally complete minimal circuit. Smaller attention11/MLP9 positive branches and MLP17 opposing correction remain outside this manifest.

identification_policy.regularization: Noise or KL may be used during discovery to reduce unstable memorization, but cannot establish semantic identity.
